name: Hikari Mi Blanc
source:
Hikari Mi Blanc is a noble from the Kingdom of Leazas. A pretty girl with short red hair and a gentle demeanor, who has mysteriously disappeared. It's her case that Rance has to solve in the first game.

[spoiler]She used to be a student attending Paris School, but was kidnapped and tortured by the then princess of Leazas, [url=/c11980]Lia Parapara Leazas[/url]. Her disappearance was the reason Rance was called to investigate the disappearance of several girls. She ended up being rescued by him.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Hikari_Mi_Blanc]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
